# Source recovery

For each assigned record, locate at most two credible original or high-quality secondary sources for the central event. Search with title, date, named people, keywords, and suggested source query. Return one terminal JSONL object per entry: entry_number, status (source_found or no_credible_source), sources (URL/title/publisher/date/confidence), supported_event_claim, and reason. Do not draft new entry text, infer wrongdoing, or change any database. A search-results URL is never a source.
